image_description: A close-up studio shot of an elaborate, vintage-style statement necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features a bib design with multiple irregular, organic-shaped pendants that appear to be made of textured metal (possibly brass or bronze) with enamel inlays in green, blue, yellow, and red. These pendants are arranged in a fan shape. The upper portion consists of a chain with faceted beads in purple, green, and amber tones. The object is centered and well-lit.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The colored 'enamel' areas on the lower pendants have a slightly muddy, painterly texture that lacks the crisp, glass-like smoothness of real vitreous enamel. It resembles AI-generated noise or digital painting rather than physical material.

artifact_observations.location: Junctions between pendants and chain links
artifact_observations.reasoning: Some connection points where the large pendants attach to the upper framework appear vague or fused. The small metal rings (jump rings) are not clearly defined, looking more like melted blobs than distinct mechanical connectors.
The facets on some of the upper beads do not follow consistent geometric logic; reflections seem arbitrary rather than following a single light source direction.

focus_areas: Connectivity of jump rings/links between pendants
Consistency of light reflection on faceted beads
Texture realism of enamel vs. metal surfaces
Edge sharpness of pendants against white background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'melted' appearance of the small connecting rings. In real jewelry photography, these are distinct circular shapes. In AI images, they often blur into the adjacent metal. Also, verify if the 'enamel' texture looks like solid glass or like digital noise/paint.
